column1: # producer   by hand: Essenthos's versification rules, read by forge frame-files
# Texts that print each psalm's superscription at the head of its first verse and say nothing about it in the file:
# no superscription marker, no stated address, no correction adding the opening, so texts/<SLUG>/titles lists none of
# those verses. Each was read psalm by psalm: the first verse of every psalm versification/titled-psalms.tsv names
# opens with the title and goes on with the psalm's first line. The frame stands such a verse at the title too, in
# those psalms only, as it does for a verse its titles product lists; a psalm whose title the text's frame already
# places (Kulish's Psalm 60, versification/supplements.tsv) is left as placed.
